verdict.rationale: Pulley documents 409A valuation turnaround (docs-10) and board/investor e-signature collection for SAFEs (docs-9), which are adjacent building blocks for equity issuance, but there is no evidence of an actual option-grant workflow that ties board approval to a 409A-compliant strike price for a new hire. missing for 10: option grant creation/issuance workflow, explicit board approval step for option grants, linkage of 409A strike price to grant issuance, any hands-on or independent confirmation of this end-to-end flow.
